description.fun: Bergmite is a little chunk of iceberg that patches the cracks in its icy shell with breath as cold as −100 °C, which also freezes enemies solid. Herds live on snowy mountaintops, and some hitch a ride by freezing themselves onto the back of an Avalugg, which carries them to new homes, much as mites hitch rides on bigger animals. It always quarrels with Frigibax.
description.guide: Bergmite is an Ice-type Pokémon from Kalos based on an iceberg. It repairs its icy covering with freezing air and lives in herds on snowy mountains, often riding on Avalugg's back. It evolves into Avalugg, or in Hisui into Hisuian Avalugg.
description.tagline: The tip of the iceberg, riding on Avalugg's back

description.fun: Avalugg is an iceberg on legs, its body as hard as steel, and with a herd of Bergmite frozen onto its flat back it looks just like an aircraft carrier as it ferries them across the sea. That likeness may nod to Project Habakkuk, a wartime plan to build an aircraft carrier out of ice. Its cracks deepen in the daytime and heal overnight, like polar ice.
description.guide: Avalugg is an Ice-type Pokémon that evolves from Bergmite, a massive creature of steel-hard ice resembling a tabular iceberg. It carries Bergmite on its flat back across oceans to new habitats. Hisui has a smaller Ice- and Rock-type Hisuian Avalugg.
description.tagline: An iceberg aircraft carrier with Bergmite for passengers

description.fun: Half the weight of Kalos's Avalugg, it's made of brown stone topped with ice, with snowplough-like jaw plates harder than steel. It ploughs through snowy fields for vegetables people have stored under the snow, and one giant Hisuian Avalugg was a Noble Pokémon of the Alabaster Icelands.

note.text: Every Bergmite that evolves in Hisui becomes Hisuian Avalugg, a smaller Ice- and Rock-type of stone and ice, wherever it came from.
